papers.title_en: Trustworthy Distributed Machine Learning in Cloud-Edge-IoT Systems: A Heterogeneity-Aware Survey of Security, Privacy, and Robustness
papers.authors: Long Dang, Ali Alfatemi, Kaiqi Xiong, Mohammed Aledhari, Abdellah Chehri, Shawqi Al-Maliki, Mohamed Rahouti
papers.evidence: 异构分布式训练与联邦学习系统综述
papers.tldr: 云—边—端物联网中的分布式机器学习虽避免集中原始数据，却因数据、资源与信任差异扩大了隐私泄露、投毒和协调攻击面。本文以联邦学习为高风险代表，构建覆盖资产、对手、信任假设与协同模式的安全边界框架。综述将统计、系统和信任异构性与收敛、公平性、攻击可检测性及防御可靠性关联，并梳理分层攻防技术。论文进一步给出兼顾隐私预算、攻击成功率、客户端差异和资源开销的评测与治理路线，为可信云边端部署提供系统指南。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed machine learning (DML), including conventional distributed training and federated learning (FL), enables collaborative model development across cloud-edge-IoT systems without fully centralizing raw data. However, distributing data, computation, updates, and orchestration increases the attack surface and introduces coupled challenges across privacy, robustness, reliability, fairness, and governance. This survey presents a security-centered, heterogeneity-aware roadmap for trustworthy DML, with FL treated as a prominent high-risk case. We first characterize the assets, adversaries, trust assumptions, and coordination patterns that define DML/FL security boundaries. We then analyze how statistical, system, and trust heterogeneity, including non-IID data, resource asymmetry, intermittent participation, and cross-silo/cross-device trust differences, affect convergence, fairness, attack detectability, and defense reliability. Next, we synthesize attack-defense interactions across poisoning, backdoors, Byzantine manipulation, privacy leakage, model extraction, network/orchestration attacks, Sybil behavior, and strategic participation. We further compare layered defenses, including robust aggregation, drift-aware optimization, differential privacy, secure aggregation, homomorphic encryption, secure multiparty computation, trusted execution environments, watermarking, provenance, authenticated communication, and monitoring. Finally, we discuss deployment, evaluation, governance, and open research guidelines, emphasizing reproducible, non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) partitions, attack-aware benchmarks, privacy budgets, attack success rate, client-level disparity, latency, communication, memory, energy/carbon overhead, and auditable lifecycle artifacts.

papers.title_en: MCCL: Training Pytorch models across a fleet of Macs at Skywalker Sound
papers.authors: Kevin Sasso, Chris Fiegel, Francis Aitken, Nicolas Tsingos, Nicholas Tong
papers.evidence: 面向苹果MPS设备的多节点PyTorch分布式后端
papers.tldr: Skywalker Sound拥有逾200台M4 Max Mac Studio，闲置时蕴含大量统一内存与算力，但PyTorch此前缺少面向MPS的多机加速通信后端。论文开源MCCL，通过交换式10Gb以太网实现Mac集群分布式训练，并保持标准PyTorch代码路径。24节点测试中，大规模全归约达到TCP有效吞吐的98%—99.7%，1.135亿参数ViT吞吐从198提升至4568样本/秒、并行效率95.9%。该工作证明现有Mac设备可转化为具成本效益的高性能训练资源。
papers.abstract_en: Skywalker Sound, a premier audio post-production facility, operates more than 200 M4 Max Mac Studios on a 10Gb Ethernet network. When not in use by artists, these machines sit idle, representing massive untapped unified memory and compute capacity. While these fleets are excellent candidates for distributed machine learning alongside existing NVIDIA GPU clusters, PyTorch lacks an accelerated distributed backend for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). To bridge this gap, we introduce the Metal Communication Collective Library (MCCL), the first open-source MPS backend for multi-node PyTorch training over switched Ethernet. We evaluate its performance and scalability across 24 nodes, demonstrating that large all-reduce operations reach 98-99.7% of TCP goodput. Training a 113.5M-parameter Vision Transformer (ViT) scales from 198 to 4,568 samples/s, achieving 95.9% parallel efficiency. Benchmarked against an NVIDIA A100 GPU, one M4 Max Mac equals roughly 1.7x the throughput of FP32 matrix multiplication, and 5.5 Macs match an A100 using TF32. Harnessing 100 idle Macs for 12 hours nightly offsets approximately $200,000 annually in equivalent cloud compute costs. Our results demonstrate that existing Mac infrastructure can be seamlessly repurposed for high performance distributed training without abandoning the standard PyTorch codebase.

papers.title_en: Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification
papers.evidence: 面向AI基础设施的智能体软硬件协同设计流程
papers.tldr: AI基础设施按芯片与软件分层设计，传统优化在建模前便排除了需软硬协同改变的方案。Formulaic让语言模型代理逐步生成带正确性条件的程序模板，再由数学求解、验证和实测分工闭环。GB10上Qwen3-8B层较SGLang快1.075倍；模拟Ventus中联合设计将最坏周期降至基线0.428。工作证明“学习制定优化问题”可拓展协同设计边界，并以可验证流程提升可信度。
papers.abstract_en: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

papers.title_en: PipeLink: Contract-Guided Linking of GPU Kernel Components
papers.evidence: 面向机器学习系统的可组合GPU内核链接
papers.tldr: 高性能机器学习内核通常由加载、矩阵乘主循环、后处理和通信等组件并发组成，但它们硬编码了共享内存、屏障、线程束与寄存器布局，难以独立编译和复用。PipeLink以组件契约为接口，分别编译组件后统一校验需求与承诺，并联合重定位流式多处理器资源、生成组件间传递。其链接内核性能与整体编译版本几乎无差异，还支持跨来源组件组成更快的注意力、MoE和GEMM融合内核。该工作将GPU内核组件化复用从手工拼接推进为可验证、近零性能损失的链接流程。
papers.abstract_en: The fastest machine-learning kernels are compositions of components, such as loaders, matrix-multiply mainloops, epilogues and communication stages, that run concurrently on one GPU streaming multiprocessor and share its on-chip memory, barriers, warps and registers. Because these components hard-code where they sit in this shared space, they cannot be compiled, shipped or replaced on their own: combining components from different sources means forking them by hand or keeping them in separate kernels. We present PipeLink, a contract-guided linker for GPU kernel components. Each component is compiled separately into an LTO object that carries a contract stating what it requires and what it promises; PipeLink checks the contracts against each other, relocates every component by solving one joint placement of the SM's resources, and generates the transfers between them, and the vendor LTO backend folds the result into constants. Across 51 configurations on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, linked kernels run within 0.2% of the same sources compiled as one unit. Linking makes new compositions practical: a CuTe attention operator inside a ThunderKittens decode megakernel speeds up decoding by 2.16$\times$, a four-owner MoE training megakernel matches the original monolith, one unchanged attention core yields sparse and context-parallel variants that outperform FlexAttention, vLLM and Transformer Engine, and a GEMM + SwiGLU composition whose consumer serves three GPU architectures runs 1.2$\times$ faster on Blackwell than cuBLAS with a compiled activation.

papers.title_en: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
papers.authors: Jiaming Hu, Zhida Jiang, Zhaolong Xing, Yu Li, Zhen Chen, Ke Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向分布式MoE训练的内存感知负载均衡
papers.tldr: 稀疏MoE虽能以较低激活成本扩展模型容量，但不均衡路由会造成专家计算和通信热点，而复制专家又挤占令牌缓冲区的显存。LRMoE在前向阶段联合规划专家放置与保留配额，保证全部路由计算完成；反向阶段按令牌—专家对的更新贡献重校准需求，并在原专家实例间容量感知分配。随后通过物理压缩缩小通信载荷并执行变长分组GEMM。在两种大模型上，相对SYMI将达到固定损失所需的累计MoE层训练时间缩短21.2%—44.8%，为显存受限节点提供了面向需求侧的高效训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

papers.title_en: Causal Attention on CPU: A Cache-Aware and Load-Balanced Scheduling Kernel for Prefill
papers.authors: Kwun Fung Lau, Frost Mitchell, Kanya Mo, Emani Ashok
papers.evidence: 面向大模型预填充的缓存感知CPU注意力内核与负载均衡调度
papers.tldr: 多智能体并发处理长上下文时，预填充阶段会占满GPU算力，CPU虽可分担负载，却受限于未适配多级缓存和线程调度的注意力内核。CACPU面向因果全序列预填充，采用分层缓存分块与内核内任务分发。其相较PyTorch SDPA、FlexAttention和SGLang注意力内核最高加速2.01倍；集成SGLang后，Llama-3.1-8B首词生成时间最高缩短至原来的约57%。该工作证明了缓存感知、负载均衡的CPU注意力可有效缓解智能体推理的GPU瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI drives significant productivity gains across diverse domains, but concurrent long-context prefills from multiple agents can saturate GPU compute resources. Although CPUs offer a viable alternative, existing CPU attention kernels fall short in adapting to multi-tier cache hierarchies and lack effective thread scheduling. To address this, we introduce CACPU, a high-performance attention kernel featuring tiered cache blocking and an in-kernel task dispatching mechanism designed for causal full-sequence prefilling. CACPU achieves up to a 2.01x speedup over PyTorch SDPA, FlexAttention, and SGLang attention kernels. Integrated into SGLang, it reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) of Llama-3.1-8B by up to 1.74x while preserving model accuracy.

papers.title_en: PhOSv1: Efficient Scaling of Model Sleeping on a Single Server for Autoscaling with GPU-Context Deduplication
papers.authors: Tianle Sun, Xingda Wei, Rong Chen
papers.evidence: 用于模型服务自动扩缩容的GPU上下文去重
papers.tldr: 模型服务自动扩缩容需要极快拉起实例，vLLM、SGLang等采用的模型休眠可保留预启动引擎，却要求每个休眠模型常驻独立GPU上下文，模型数增加时显存开销线性上升并拖累在线服务。PhOSv1发现休眠模型的CUDA上下文和内核二进制高度重复，通过API远程调用将上下文分配集中给守护进程，实现跨引擎透明去重。实验表明，其保持原生vLLM休眠模式的扩容速度，同时显著降低显存占用并改善多模型端到端服务性能。该工作缓解了“全模型快速扩容”与“高吞吐服务”之间的资源矛盾。
papers.abstract_en: Autoscaling is a key mechanism in model-as-a-service systems, where fast scale-up is essential because the scale-up time directly determines how long a model service remains overloaded, which in turn governs serving quality. The state-of-the-art approach, model sleeping, adopted by mainstream serving engines including vLLM and SGLang, achieves near-zero-cost scale-up by pausing pre-spawned engines on the GPU. However, sleeping is not a free lunch: each sleeping model must keep its GPU context resident, and this cost grows linearly with the number of models, degrading serving performance. Because providers must support many models, they face a dilemma between fast scale-up for all models and high service performance.   In this paper, we show that a single server can keep many models asleep without paying this GPU context tax. The key observation is that the contexts of sleeping models are largely duplicated: the driver (CUDA) context can be shared across models, and their GPU kernel binaries overlap heavily due to common operators and libraries. PhOSv1 deduplicates this context by transparently delegating each engine's GPU context allocation to a central daemon through API remoting; therefore, a single server can keep far more models asleep than current engines allow. Our evaluation shows that PhOSv1 matches the scale-up time of vanilla vLLM sleep mode while substantially reducing the GPU memory footprint, improving end-to-end multi-model serving performance.

papers.title_en: JustGoal: With Only a Goal, the AI Baseline Is Above the Expert Kernels
papers.authors: Yaojian Chen, Dazhi Peng, Zhui Zhu, Leshan Li, Haojun Sun, Yiyun Zheng, Qingfeng He, Shangzhan Li, Xianglong Deng, Yifei Shen, Shengye Xiang, Zhen Li, Lin Gan, Yuxuan Li, Xu Han, Zhiyuan Liu
papers.evidence: 面向大模型训练与推理的GPU内核优化
papers.tldr: 大模型训练与推理的效率常由少数GPU算子决定，传统高性能内核开发依赖专家、专用知识库和搜索评测流程。本文提出JustGoal：通用智能体仅获得优化目标与约束，不提供内核专属基础设施或预定义工作流，并自行构建评测闭环。在NVIDIA B200上，它在10个算子中的8个超过开源库，单算子几何平均加速1.14至2.34倍，并在可比的9项中5项胜过公开专用智能体内核。研究表明，专用机制的价值应以同模型、同范围的目标驱动基线为准，并随基础模型演进重新验证。
papers.abstract_en: A small number of GPU kernels often determines the efficiency of large language model training and inference. High-performance kernel development typically relies on expert knowledge through manual implementation, collaboration with general-purpose models, or specialized agents equipped with domain knowledge, evaluation methods, and search workflows. We investigate how much value this knowledge provides as foundation models become stronger. We introduce JustGoal, a goal-only baseline in which a general-purpose agent receives only the optimization objective and constraints, without kernel-specific infrastructure, knowledge bases, or predefined workflows, and builds its own evaluation loop. On NVIDIA B200 GPUs, JustGoal outperforms open-source libraries on 8 of 10 operators, achieving per-operator geometric mean speedups of 1.14x to 2.34x. It also surpasses the fastest publicly released specialized-agent kernel on 5 of 9 operators with available comparisons. In a controlled same-model comparison using Fable 5.1 on single shapes, the KDA-0.5 harness reaches 0.95x of JustGoal's performance, while single-mechanism ablations show no consistent benefit from domain knowledge or predefined workflows. These results indicate that specialized machinery should be justified by clear gains over a same-model, same-scope goal-only baseline and reevaluated whenever the foundation model changes.

papers.title_en: Request-Adaptive Execution for Efficient Hybrid LLM Inference
papers.authors: Fahao Chen, Xuzhe Yan, Qi Zhang, Peng Li, Dongxiao Yu, Song Guo
papers.evidence: 请求自适应的大模型服务系统协同设计
papers.tldr: 混合大语言模型将注意力与状态空间模型结合，但固定层布局迫使所有请求走相同路径，难以适应不同的上下文依赖，造成在线服务效率损失。Morph在每个块内配对两类层，依据预填充阶段门控为请求选择布局，并在解码期间保持不变。运行时通过选择性批处理和混合感知上下文缓存处理分歧执行与前缀复用。在六个数据集上，它改善质量—效率权衡，系统吞吐最高较基线提升3.87倍，并降低延迟，表明模型—系统协同可实现请求自适应推理。
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising way to combine the modeling capability of the Attention mechanism with the efficiency of state space models (SSMs). However, most existing hybrid LLMs still inherit a static design philosophy: once the Attention-to-SSM layout is chosen, every request must follow the same hybrid execution. This one-layout-fits-all design is inefficient for real-world serving workloads, where different requests rely on contextual information in different ways.   This paper presents Morph, a serving system that co-designs the model architecture and runtime for request-adaptive hybrid LLM inference. Its model architecture pairs Attention and SSM layers within each block and uses prefill-oriented gating to select a request-specific layout that remains fixed throughout decoding. Its serving runtime preserves batching efficiency under divergent layer choices through selective batching and enables correct prefix reuse through hybrid-aware context caching. Experiments on six datasets show that Morph achieves a better quality-efficiency trade-off than existing static hybrid baselines. System-level evaluation further shows that Morph improves the serving throughput by up to 3.87x over baselines while substantially reducing inference latency.

papers.title_en: GearUp: DAG-aware Acceleration for Serverless Inference Serving via Slack-guided Pre-loading
papers.authors: Qi Qi, Yifan Sui, Hanfei Yu, Hong Zhang, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 面向无服务器机器学习推理的GPU感知DAG预加载基础设施
papers.tldr: 无服务器平台上的机器学习推理常由函数DAG组成，库、模型权重与CUDA内核加载会沿依赖路径累积，成为端到端延迟瓶颈。GearUp剖析节点加载阶段，利用上游执行产生的松弛时间提前调度加载，并跨请求复用已初始化实例。其流量自适应保活策略在冷启动风险与内存占用间权衡。在两类工作流上，系统显著降低延迟和资源分配，证明DAG感知的松弛调度可高效隐藏初始化开销。
papers.abstract_en: Serverless platforms increasingly host machine learning (ML) inference workflows, modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of interdependent functions. Beyond container startup, each ML node must load libraries, model weights, and CUDA kernels before it can run. These costs accumulate along dependent DAG paths and place initialization on the end-to-end critical path. Existing systems optimize one half of this problem. DAG-agnostic pre-loading prepares nodes the request may never reach, wasting host and GPU memory. DAG-aware serving routes and scales whole functions, leaving the loading stages inside a node untouched. This paper presents GearUp, a serverless DAG inference serving system that removes ML-node loading from the end-to-end critical path at low resource cost. GearUp profiles the loading stages of each node and schedules them inside the slack time the DAG exposes, hiding initialization behind upstream execution. It reuses initialized instances within and across requests to avoid redundant cold starts. A probabilistic, traffic-adaptive keep-alive policy sets how long idle instances are retained, balancing memory cost against cold-start risk under bursty load. On the AMBER Alert and FINRA-ML workflows with NVIDIA L40S GPUs, GearUp reduces median end-to-end latency by 64.5% and 75.9% against SMIless, for median speedups of 3.1x and 10.0x over cold execution. Integrated GPU and host memory allocation fall by up to 83.9% and 94.6% against eager pre-loading in InstaInfer. GearUp achieves 4.2x strong scaling on four workers.

papers.title_en: LLM-PowerTrace: A Dataset of Time-Resolved GPU Power Traces for AI Compute
papers.authors: Jiansheng Wang, Jaskeerat Singh, Haochen Xu, Xinyi Li, Mingyuan Yan, Shaohui Liu, Yuzhuo Li, Yize Chen, Wenqi Cui
papers.evidence: 支持AI基础设施管理的逐GPU时序功耗数据
papers.tldr: 大语言模型训练与推理正形成规模大、变化快的电力负荷，但现有基准多只报告每词元能耗等聚合指标，难以刻画峰值、爬坡和多卡同步波动。论文提出LLM-PowerTrace，公开以100毫秒采样的逐GPU功率时间序列及完整工作负载、系统元数据。数据覆盖多类英伟达平台、模型规模及训练和推理关键配置扫描，并据此定义面向电网的指标与功率—能耗缩放律。该资源为AI负荷预测、数据中心调度和电网影响建模提供了基础。
papers.abstract_en: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and difficult to model. We introduce LLM-PowerTrace, an open dataset of time-resolved, per-GPU power traces for LLM fine-tuning and inference, sampled every 100\,ms on varying NVIDIA platforms paired with complete workload and system metadata. For fine-tuning, LLM-PowerTrace profiles open model families spanning a wide range of model sizes and fine-tuning methods, together with controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing. For inference, it covers variations in concurrency, GPU frequency, KV-cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request-arrival patterns. LLM-PowerTrace profiles a set of open model families across a wide range of model sizes, and controlled sweeps over batch size, sequence length, precision, parallelism, and checkpointing for fine-tuning, and it sweeps concurrency, GPU frequency, KV cache and weight quantization, prompt and output lengths, and request arrival patterns for inference. Built upon power traces, we define power-grid-facing metrics as well as AI-compute power\&energy scaling law for extrapolating beyond the measured settings. Together, LLM-PowerTrace provides a dataset foundation for modeling, forecasting, and managing the fast-changing electrical behavior of AI compute.

papers.title_en: SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching
papers.authors: Yuhan Tang, Tiejun Li, Jianmin Zhang, An Hu, Guangyu Sun, Sheng Ma, Yiqun Lang, Hanqing Li, Siqing Fu
papers.evidence: 面向加速器工作负载的GPU内存系统优化
papers.tldr: GPU虽依赖大量线程隐藏访存延迟，但当众多warp同时等待数据时仍会严重停顿；仅提高地址预测准确率不足以带来收益。SnakeCharmer将候选地址生成与预取落地控制解耦，联合决定预取是否发出、何时发出及数据存放位置。其以零价值过滤、分层反馈距离调节和寄存器辅助缓冲区协同优化效用、及时性与放置。在A100模型上，它相对Snake提升性能/能效12.8%/20.8%，并可迁移至APOGEE，证明统一后端控制的普适价值。
papers.abstract_en: GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another.   We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filtering for utility, hierarchical feedback-driven distance tuning for timeliness, and a register-assisted prefetch buffer for placement. We design and implement SnakeCharmer primarily on top of Snake, and adapt the same backend-control principles to APOGEE to demonstrate that SnakeCharmer's benefits are not limited to a single frontend predictor. On an A100 GPU model, SnakeCharmer improves performance/energy efficiency by 12.8%/20.8% over Snake and by 1.7%/3.2% over APOGEE, with modest hardware overhead.

papers.title_en: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
papers.authors: Sebastian Loeschcke, Ivan Koryakovskiy, Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa, Riccardo Del Chiaro, Mart van Baalen, Paul N. Whatmough, Markus Nagel
papers.evidence: 面向十亿参数大模型训练与部署效率的量化感知训练
papers.tldr: 低比特大语言模型中，格点向量量化具备较佳率失真权衡，但其量化感知训练的优化机制与大规模可扩展性尚不清楚。SQuAT将权重分解为方向和幅值，分别进行球面码本量化与低比特标量量化，并采用独立直通估计器。方向更新因而近似球面流形优化；配合分布式精确近邻分配，训练加速12.8倍并扩展至100亿词元。在多种LLaMA和Qwen模型上，该方法在相同量化器与初始化下稳定优于标准方案，达到当前最佳精度。
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.

papers.title_en: GS-MoE: Training-Free MoE Compression via Groupwise Subspace Sharing and Pruning
papers.authors: Carson Cary, Yukai Jin, Yihao Huang, Zhankai Ye, Fangyi Li, Ting Hua, Xin Liu, Shangqian Gao
papers.evidence: 面向可扩展AI服务的免训练MoE内存压缩
papers.tldr: 稀疏激活虽降低了 MoE 推理计算，但大量专家参数仍造成显著存储瓶颈。GS-MoE 在无需训练的条件下，联合压缩跨专家共享子空间秩与专家内部中间层宽度，并按层、组和专家分级分配预算。在 DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base 上削减60%总参数时，其平均推理能力保留约原模型的90%，明显优于 D²-MoE 的73%，域外困惑度也低20%。该方法表明双轴、非均匀压缩能在高压缩率下更好保留细粒度 MoE 性能。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse activation, but storing their expert parameters remains a major memory bottleneck. We introduce GS-MoE, a training-free compression framework that addresses redundancy across and within experts through two compression axes: shared-subspace rank and expert intermediate width. Groupwise low-rank representations capture shared structure across experts while retaining expert-specific projections, and Nyström-based neuron compression reduces intermediate width within each expert. For fixed shared subspaces, we derive per-expert reconstruction-error reductions from the reconstruction objective and use them to guide expert grouping. Budgets are allocated hierarchically using a gradient-free layer-importance score to guide the allocation of rank and width budgets across layers, which eigenvalues and leverage then distribute as non-uniform ranks across groups and intermediate widths across experts. Experiments demonstrate the complementary benefits of compression along both axes, particularly at high compression rates on fine-grained MoE models. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base, at a 60% reduction in total model parameters, GS-MoE retains approximately 90% of the uncompressed model's average reasoning performance, compared with 73% for D$^2$-MoE, while achieving 20% lower out-of-domain perplexity. We provide a code implementation at: https://github.com/cbacary/GS-MoE

papers.title_en: Modeling Liquid-Cooled Data Centers in EnergyPlus
papers.authors: Yun-Dam Ko, Dipashreya A. Sur, Cade Napier, Carlos D. Díaz-Marín, Rishee K. Jain
papers.evidence: 面向AI数据中心的液冷基础设施建模
papers.tldr: 面向高密度AI机架的芯片直冷液冷正在普及，但现有工具难以评估整栋数据中心的多年运行效率。论文在EnergyPlus中新增原生液冷IT设备对象，统一耦合设施水环、机架二次环、冷却液分配单元与芯片结温。其与独立Modelica模型在21种工况及全年分钟级仿真中高度一致，温度RMSE不高于0.021 K。案例表明温水液冷可将年均PUE由1.43降至1.25、消除现场用水并降低37.9%总能耗，为开源长期建筑级液冷评估提供工具。
papers.abstract_en: As AI workloads accelerate data center transition toward high-density racks with direct-to-chip (DTC) liquid cooling, existing simulation tools remain limited in evaluating whole-building and multi-year efficiency. To bridge this gap, we develop a native EnergyPlus object, ElectricEquipment:ITE:LiquidCooled, that models DTC liquid cooling for chilled-water and warm-water architectures as plant-loop components. It couples facility-water loops, rack-side secondary loops, coolant distribution units, and chip-junction temperatures within a single solver. Validation against an independent Modelica implementation across 21 operating conditions, including two full-year runs compared at one-minute resolution, yields loop-temperature RMSE at or below 0.021 K, well within the 0.1 K acceptance threshold. Our case study demonstrates that warm-water liquid cooling reduces annual PUE from 1.43 to 1.25, eliminates on-site water use, and cuts total facility energy by 37.9% relative to an air-cooled baseline. By embedding liquid-cooling logic into EnergyPlus, our work provides whole-building, long-term energy modeling for high-density AI infrastructure within an open-source framework.

papers.title_en: Geodesic-SVDD Latent Mixup for One-Shot Distributed Tabular Learning
papers.authors: Andrea Moleri, Christian Internò, Markus Olhofer, Barbara Hammer, Ali Raza
papers.evidence: 面向标签偏斜表格客户端的联邦学习框架
papers.tldr: 隐私敏感的分布式表格学习中，树模型难适配联邦梯度优化，深度分类器又易在标签偏斜下遗忘。论文提出Geodesic-SVDD，将客户端任务转为超球面一类密度估计，并用测地潜变量混合维持表示几何。其单轮专家乘积聚合避免迭代同步；五个基准上平均AUROC居七种方法之首，Covertype较联邦树最高提升21点。该工作为高偏斜、低通信的隐私表格建模提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed Learning on structured data is a key and widely adopted approach in privacy-sensitive sectors, ranging from financial fraud prevention to federated healthcare diagnostics. While Gradient Boosted Decision Trees are widely used in centralized settings due to their efficiency, they are incompatible with standard gradient-based federated learning protocols because of their non-differentiability. Conversely, standard deep classifiers that are amenable to federated optimization often suffer from catastrophic forgetting under label distribution skew. In this work, to address these gaps we propose Geodesic-SVDD, a framework for Distributed Spherical Prototype Learning that recasts each client's task as one-class density estimation on the hypersphere, so that local models can be aggregated as probabilistic manifolds in a single round. Specifically, for each client, we employ a Residual Spherical Encoder and Geodesic Latent Mixup that enforces strict hyperspherical constraints ($\|φ(x)\| \equiv 1$), preventing the manifold collapse observed in linear approximations. Furthermore, leveraging this insight, we propose a novel One-Shot "Product of Experts" protocol that enables privacy-preserving aggregation without iterative synchronization. Finally, we mechanistically analyze the trade-off between interpolation strategies, demonstrating that while linear mixup offers an enticing computational shortcut, it destabilizes optimization gradients by orders of magnitude ($10^9\times$). Across five tabular benchmarks and four levels of label skew, Geodesic-SVDD attains the highest mean AUROC among seven federated methods, outperforms federated tree ensembles by up to 21 AUROC points on Covertype, and its One-Shot variant matches centralized Deep SVDD under IID and mild skew with a single communication round.

papers.title_en: Projection-Based Federated Learning on Compact Submanifolds with Geometry-Independent Differential Privacy
papers.authors: Thibault Pautrel, Florent Bouchard, Guillaume Ginolhac, Ammar Mian, Aurélien Bellet
papers.evidence: 隐私保护的联邦训练方法
papers.tldr: 联邦学习不交换原始数据，但客户端更新仍会泄露记录；参数位于流形时，隐私噪声和聚合更困难。论文提出DP-RFedProj，在固定环境空间私有化梯度，以闭式投影聚合紧致子流形更新，支持多步本地训练和间歇参与。方法给出不依赖流形几何、聚合和本地优化器的全程记录级f-DP保证；并证明特定配置下收敛，隐私项随内在维度而非环境维度增长。联邦PCA与SPDNet实验显示，同预算下所需噪声少5至6倍，分类效用优于欧氏基线。
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning trains a shared model across clients without exchanging their data, yet the updates they transmit still leak information about individual records. Enforcing differential privacy is harder still when the model parameters lie on a Riemannian manifold. Existing methods rebuild the noise added for privacy in the geometry of each new iterate, aggregate through intrinsic maps that often lack a closed form, and prove convergence only in restricted regimes. We introduce DP-RFedProj, a record-level differentially private federated learning method for compact submanifolds that aggregates through closed-form projections and privatises gradients in a fixed ambient geometry. Each client may run any stochastic first-order optimiser, take several local steps, and participate only intermittently. An explicit record-level $f$-DP guarantee holds for the entire training transcript, independently of the manifold, the aggregation scheme and the local optimiser. We establish convergence of DP-RFedProj when each client runs Riemannian SGD locally and the server aggregates by projected averaging, and show that privacy enters the rate through a term scaling with the manifold's intrinsic dimension rather than the ambient one. Synthetic experiments on federated PCA over the Grassmann manifold corroborate these findings. On EEG motor-imagery classification with SPDNet, whose weights lie on the Stiefel manifold, the method outperforms a Euclidean baseline at every privacy budget considered. In both experimental settings, our accounting requires five to six times less noise than that of the closest prior method for the same budget, which translates into higher utility.

papers.authors: Xingjian Bai, Jia-Hao Liang, Jayden Teoh, Vincent Sitzmann
papers.evidence: 自适应优化模型训练配方与数值设置
papers.tldr: 在未针对目标任务调优训练配方时，固定优化器往往难以及时应对训练动态、数据异常和过拟合。OPAL引入预训练语言模型代理，在一次训练过程中检查状态并直接改写可执行优化器代码，可分别调整参数组的更新规则与调度。它无需针对优化器的元训练，也不从其他运行迁移记忆。在语言建模和图像生成测试中，方法达到或优于选定固定配方，并展现对重复数据损坏的适应及抑制过拟合能力，为训练时自适应优化设计提供证据。
papers.abstract_en: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.
